_note: MÍMISBRUNNR production stability gates (H182). Each gate: metric, measurement method, PASS threshold (a number), the slice producing the measurement, and a one-sentence justification. NO-GO branch (F1 CPU path) — H184 is skipped per docs/fallback/RESCOPED_PLAN.md, so no NPU gates appear here.

gates.justification: Any crash or hang during the soak is a release blocker.
gates.measurement_method: fraction of failed generations (crash or hang) over the H183 4h soak, from data/gauntlet/soak_cpu_4h.log

gates.justification: The soak must complete the full 4 hours to count as a stability proof.
gates.measurement_method: wall-clock hours the H183 soak ran, from data/gauntlet/soak_cpu_4h.log

gates.justification: Throughput must not regress more than 10% across the soak window (no slowdown drift).
gates.measurement_method: abs(final-30min median tok/s / first-30min median tok/s - 1) over the H183 soak

gates.justification: Every injected fault must be handled; an unhandled fault is a warden blind spot.
gates.measurement_method: injected-but-unhandled faults from the H186 fault-injection campaign, cross-reconciled against the VÖRÐR handling log

gates.justification: The inference process must never crash under fault injection.
gates.measurement_method: process crashes (non-zero exits, signals) observed during the H186 60-minute fault-injection run

gates.justification: Every restart must return to full service, or the recovery path cannot be trusted at 3 AM.
gates.measurement_method: fraction of the 20 H187 scripted restarts that reached ready/service with greedy output matching the pre-storm reference exactly

gates.justification: Greedy inference must be bit-identical across runs and restarts; nondeterminism hides state leaks.
gates.measurement_method: fraction of the H188 10-run greedy sequences (5 prompts) that are token-identical, plus 5/5 after process restart

gates.justification: Memory growth above 1 MB/hour indicates an unbounded leak, not cache fill.
gates.measurement_method: OLS slope of process RSS (MB) vs time over the second hour of the H189 2h inference run

gates.justification: A release must generate coherent text on models it has never seen before.
gates.measurement_method: fraction of H195 victory-gate prompts passing every item of the frozen data/armvegr/coherence_rubric.json
